papers.title_en: Training-Free Inpainting Across Domains with a Frozen Text-to-Image Diffusion Model
papers.evidence: 冻结文生图扩散模型用于跨域条件修复，体现扩散概率模型的生成能力
papers.tldr: 现有基于扩散模型的修复方法多依赖特定任务的训练或条件通道。本文提出Step-PI，利用冻结的通用文本到图像扩散模型实现跨域条件修复，无需针对修复的权重训练或数据集适配。其核心是在已知区域投影基础上增加边界-内部潜在反馈、持久PI状态及预定义四阶段释放调度，沿反向轨迹调节控制信号。在CelebA-HQ上开发后直接迁移至AFHQ和Places2，在多个指标上优于LanPaint和PILOT等无训练基线，为跨域修复提供了一种测试时潜在控制的互补方案。
papers.abstract_en: We show that a frozen generic text-to-image diffusion model can perform conditional inpainting across three evaluated natural-image domains with one fixed controller configuration, without inpainting-specific weight training, dataset-specific weight adaptation, or learned inpainting-specific conditioning channels. Step-PI augments known-region projection with boundary-interior latent feedback, persistent PI state, and a predefined four-field release schedule that modulates controller signals along the reverse trajectory. Developed only on Main35-disjoint CelebA-HQ pilots, the controller transfers unchanged to AFHQ and Places2. Across two field-identical comparisons on the same 3,500 cases, adding persistent state and replacing uniform release with the predefined schedule each improve all 15 dataset-metric cells; 95% bootstrap intervals exclude zero for all five metrics in both comparisons. In descriptive native-route comparisons, Step-PI leads LanPaint and PILOT (the closest evaluated training-free baselines using vanilla SD1.5) on all five equal-dataset macro metrics. Inpainting-trained systems retain the absolute metric leads but rely on substantial inpainting-specific offline optimization. Our method provides a complementary approach for repurposing a frozen generic text-to-image model for cross-domain inpainting through test-time latent control.

papers.title_en: Step Back to Move Forward: Reflection-Aware Preference Optimization for Visual Generation
papers.authors: Junlong Wu, Jiuzhou Lin, Jia Sun, Boheng Zhang, Huaiqing Wang, Dewen Fan, Houde Liu, Qianqian Gan, Fan Yang, Tingting Gao
papers.evidence: 提出反思感知GRPO对扩散生成模型做偏好对齐后训练，提升图像与视频生成质量
papers.tldr: 扩散模型虽主导视觉生成，但RL偏好对齐方法探索低效且易陷局部最优，损害语义与真实感。为此提出RA-GRPO，利用扩散反射修正中间采样轨迹，并通过反事实路径合成蒸馏进策略，实现反向反思辅助前向优化。在T2I和T2V上显著优于现有方法，缓解奖励黑客并提升泛化，且模型无关、易集成，为稳定偏好对齐提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have become the mainstream paradigm for modern visual generation and have substantially advanced multimedia content synthesis, especially in text-to-image and text-to-video tasks. To further align such generative models with human preferences, reinforcement learning (RL) has recently shown strong potential as a post-training strategy. Nevertheless, existing policy gradient-based methods often explore inefficiently, making them vulnerable to local optima that may degrade semantic faithfulness and visual realism. To address these challenges, we present Reflection-Aware GRPO (RA-GRPO), a new RL-based preference alignment framework for diffusion generative models. The core idea is to improve "forward" generation by incorporating "backward" reflection during optimization. We first introduce Diffusion Reflection, which rectifies intermediate sampling trajectories by inverting the diffusion process with a weak estimator, guiding latent states toward higher-probability regions of the true data manifold. Furthermore, we introduce Counterfactual Path Synthesis to implicitly distill these rectified trajectories into the policy, enabling the model to internalize the benefits of search-based exploration without incurring inference-time overhead. Extensive experiments on T2I and T2V models demonstrate that RA-GRPO significantly outperforms existing methods, particularly in mitigating reward hacking and improving generalization. The method remains architecture-agnostic and integrates seamlessly with standard pipelines, suggesting a promising direction for stable preference alignment.
